definitions.gloss: commercial district; commercial area; business zone
definitions.explanation: An area designated or used primarily for shops, offices, and other commercial activities. Used in both urban planning and everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: ここは{商業地|しょうぎょうち}だ。
{駅前|えきまえ}は{商業地|しょうぎょうち}として{発展|はってん}した。
examples.english: The area in front of the station developed as a commercial district.

examples.japanese: {商業地|しょうぎょうち}の{地価|ちか}は{住宅地|じゅうたくち}より{高|たか}い{傾向|けいこう}がある。
examples.english: Land prices in commercial districts tend to be higher than in residential areas.

notes:
Compound of {商業|しょうぎょう} (commerce) + {地|ち} (land/area).

LAND USE TYPES:
- {商業地|しょうぎょうち}: commercial area
- {住宅地|じゅうたくち}: residential area
- {工業地|こうぎょうち}: industrial area
- {農地|のうち}: farmland

RELATED WORDS:
- {商業地域|しょうぎょうちいき}: commercial zone (official urban planning category)
- {商業施設|しょうぎょうしせつ}: commercial facility (shopping mall, etc.)
- {繁華街|はんかがい}: busy shopping/entertainment district

USAGE:
Appears in urban planning, real estate, and news contexts. {地価|ちか} (land prices) in {商業地|しょうぎょうち} are typically higher than in residential areas. Station-front areas ({駅前|えきまえ}) are often {商業地|しょうぎょうち}.
